symptom: go mod tidy keeps changing go.mod or go.sum, and the gate reports drift on every run.
cause: An import references a module that is not in require, or a dependency was added transitively and is now used directly.
steps: Run go_mod with op='tidy' and read the diff it reports.
If a new direct dependency appeared, that is a review decision, not a formatting one — stop and say which module and why it is needed.
If it is a private module, check GOPRIVATE covers gitlab.cept.gov.in before assuming the requirement is wrong.
Re-run the gate. Tidy must be a no-op there.
watch_out: The reference template's own go.mod requires api-db while the code imports n-api-db. Tidy will want to fix that, and fixing it is correct — but it is a template bug, so report it rather than burying it in an unrelated change.
